page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hpc8ae.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 processors. Operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz, this instance provides 64 dedicated virtual CPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The underlying virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

This server type does not include bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage attachments. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high clock-speed AMD EPYC processors position this instance for workloads requiring consistent compute performance without resource contention. The balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it suitable for general-purpose high-performance computing, multi-threaded simulation tasks, application servers, and distributed enterprise workloads that require high baseline network throughput but do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
